source: Pre-registered hypothesis H1 (claude/PLAN.md §4), parameters fixed from the literature, not fitted to this data

preregistration.hypothesis: H1: crypto perpetuals trend at multi-week horizons (time-series momentum). An ensemble of the 12-day, 30-day and 84-day horizons is more robust than any single one. This file is the 12-day leg; the 30-day leg is the benchmark (research/external/benchmark-tsmom-4h-30d.json).
preregistration.why_these_parameters: Same construction as the benchmark (30-day volatility units, entry at 0.5, exit when momentum turns, 4xATR catastrophic stop, nothing optimised); only the lookback differs. 12 and 84 days are the documented 2-12 week TSMOM horizons and the family's limits on 4h candles (72-504 bars); 7 and 90 days, as first planned, fall outside them.
preregistration.role: Evidence: this id in the forward book, forward-tested on unseen data from registration, never re-optimised, never removed, reported apart from the research verdict. Since 2026-11-22 (owner's decision) the same configuration also trades on demo as the core sleeve core-tsmom-4h-12d; its demo results are reported separately and never replace the forward record.
preregistration.decision_rule: Forward v2 (claude/PLAN.md §6): judged at 90 days of forward data against the benchmark and BTC (alpha, Newey-West); 'works' needs the anytime-valid t threshold.
preregistration.stop_rule: Stop the hypothesis if its forward drawdown exceeds the 99th percentile of its backtest distribution; record it, do not tune it.

provenance.selected_on: Family chosen on this system's own OOS results; lookback from the literature's 2-12 week horizons, not fitted.

seen_data.what: the lab's walk-forward history of the tsmom family: 365-day training + 360-day OOS before each run (1h from 20.11.2026, 4h from 21.11.2026)
the choice itself: tsmom became the benchmark and the core because it was the only family with a non-negative mean OOS Sharpe in 215 lab trials (METHOD_REVIEW, 21.11.2026)

provenance.clean_evidence: Clean evidence is the forward test from the freeze only. A one-off read on any period before the freeze is a replication: it can reject, never confirm (the same rule as clean_oos). PLAN B4's 'sealed last 12 months' is not sealed for this configuration.
